contract.words: Collect $10,000 of settled cash within 16 days with at most $375 of capital.

strategy.title: No executable plan: no held opening establishes $10,000 of settled cash in 16 days
strategy.why: The only opening priced near the target (GitHub, $10,000) rests on a bug-bounty reward for a critical vulnerability finding, which is a reward and not a purchase price, from a single organisation, with no evidence a finding would be made, accepted and paid within 16 days; the spreadsheet templates sell at $9 and would need 1,112 sales with no evidenced buyer volume, channel or conversion; domain assistance at $75 has no fulfiller and no reachable buyer.

alternatives.title: Sell $9 spreadsheet templates
alternatives.why: 1,112 sales needed in 16 days; buyer volume, reachable channel and conversion are not evidenced; Brain's held reach tops out at $1,800.

alternatives.title: GitHub bug bounty
alternatives.why: A bounty is a reward for an uncertain finding, not a price a buyer pays for a deliverable; one organisation; payout timing unestablished; card's deliverable (a spreadsheet) does not match a security finding.

alternatives.title: Domain purchase assistance
alternatives.why: $75 per transaction, no fulfiller named, no reachable buyer; 134 transactions would be needed.

noPlan.decisiveGap: No held opening has an evidenced purchase price and buyer volume that can carry $10,000 within 16 days: the $10,000 figure is a bug-bounty reward from one organisation (not a price), and the evidenced priced openings ($9 templates, $75 domain help) have no evidenced reachable buyer volume and reach at most $1,800.
noPlan.resolution: Research and construct openings with a sourced purchase price, a counted reachable buyer population, a fulfiller and settlement inside 16 days that together carry $10,000 within $375 of capital; or the owner lowers the target or extends the window.
